page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance profile. Single-core processing is limited, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the weak and poor categories respectively. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by PassMark CPU and Geekbench multi-core benchmarks. Memory bandwidth is average, reaching 75.3 GB/sec for large-block read operations, though the PassMark memory score is relatively weak. Database operations and Redis SET performance remain in the average tier.

Given the dedicated Intel Xeon cores and high memory density, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require high single-threaded performance. The lack of local storage and moderate 3 Gbps network bandwidth are key tradeoffs to consider. It is best suited for memory-intensive applications such as medium-sized databases, caching layers like Redis, static web serving, and multi-threaded text or image processing tasks.
